english: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 将3个伤害指示物，以任意方式放置于对手的宝可梦身上。

english: Put 8 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 将8个伤害指示物，以任意方式放置于对手的宝可梦身上。

english: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 给对手的战斗宝可梦身上，放置5个伤害指示物。

english: Put 7 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 给对手的战斗宝可梦身上，放置7个伤害指示物。

english: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中的1张宝可梦，放于备战区。

english: Put up to 3 {{e|Water}} Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中最多3张{{e|水}}宝可梦，放于备战区。

english: Put up to 3 {{e|Dragon}} Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中最多3张{{e|龙}}宝可梦，放于备战区。

english: Put up to 3 Duskull from your discard pile onto your Bench.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中最多3张「夜巡灵」，放于备战区。

english: Each player draws 3 cards.
chinese: 双方玩家，各从牌库上方抽取3张卡牌。

english: Your opponent chooses 1 of their Benched Pokémon and switches it with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
chinese: 对手选择对手自己的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，令新出场的宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|睡眠}}'''状态。

english: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. The new Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
chinese: 选择对手的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，令新出场的宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|睡眠}}'''状态。

english: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
chinese: 若希望，可选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，放回对手的手牌。

english: Put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
chinese: 选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，放回对手的手牌。

english: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 若希望，可选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，转附于对手的备战宝可梦身上。

english: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
chinese: 选择自己或对手，被选择的玩家，将所有手牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。然后，被选择的玩家从牌库上方抽取4张卡牌。

english: If you go second and it's your first turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
chinese: 如果是后攻玩家的最初回合的话，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {{e|Dragon}} Pokémon, it is now Paralyzed.
chinese: 如果对手的战斗宝可梦是{{e|龙}}宝可梦的话，则令那只宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: If you have exactly 1 Prize card remaining, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
chinese: 如果自己的剩余奖赏卡张数为1张的话，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: If {{TCG|Flamigo}} is on your Bench, this attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. ''(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)''
chinese: 如果自己的备战区中有「缠红鹤」的话，则给对手的1只备战宝可梦，也造成60伤害。''[备战宝可梦不计算弱点、抗性。]''

english: If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack also does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. ''(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)''
chinese: 如果自己牌库的剩余张数在3张及以下的话，则给对手的2只备战宝可梦，也各造成120伤害。''[备战宝可梦不计算弱点、抗性。]''

english: If a Stadium is in play, this attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and discard that Stadium. ''(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)''
chinese: 如果场上有竞技场的话，则给对手所有的备战宝可梦，也各造成30伤害，将那张竞技场放于弃牌区。''''[备战宝可梦不计算弱点、抗性。]''''

english: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on that Pokémon.
chinese: 给对手的1只宝可梦，造成50伤害。这个招式的伤害，不计算弱点、抗性，以及受到伤害的宝可梦身上所附加的效果。

english: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦在使用招式时，对手将抛掷1次硬币。如果为反面则那个招式失败。

english: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips 2 coins. If either of them is tails, that attack doesn't happen.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦在使用招式时，对手将抛掷2次硬币。只要出现1次反面，那么那个招式失败。

english: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦在使用招式时，对手将抛掷1次硬币。如果为反面则那个招式失败。

english: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦在使用招式时，对手将抛掷1次硬币。如果为反面则那个招式失败。

english: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
chinese: 选择对手战斗宝可梦所拥有的1个招式。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，将无法使用被选择的招式。

english: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
chinese: 选择对手战斗宝可梦所拥有的1个招式。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，将无法使用被选择的招式。

english: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
chinese: 选择对手战斗宝可梦所拥有的1个招式。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦将无法使用被选择的招式。

english: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is {{e|无}} more.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，'''撤退'''所需能量增加1个。

english: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost {{e|无}} more, and its Retreat Cost is {{e|无}} more.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，使用招式所需能量和'''撤退'''所需能量，各增加1个{{e|无}}能量。

english: During your opponent's next turn, attacks that the Defending Pokémon uses cost {{e|无色}}{{e|无色}} more.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，使用招式所需能量，增加2个{{e|无}}能量。

english: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost {{e|Colorless}} more, and its Retreat Cost is {{e|Colorless}} more.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，使用招式所需能量和'''撤退'''所需能量，各增加1个{{e|无}}能量。

english: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Excited Punch attack does 60 more damage ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦使用的「振奋拳」的伤害「+60」。

english: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 100 more damage ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦的「回声」的伤害「+100」。

english: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Spinning Needles attack does 100 more damage ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦的「旋压尖刺」的伤害「+100」。

english: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Slicing Blade attack does 80 more damage ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦的「薄片利刃」的伤害「+80」。

english: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Meteor Mash attack does 60 more damage ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦使用的「彗星拳」的伤害「+60」。

english: During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦所使用的招式，给对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害「+120」。

english: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，这只宝可梦的弱点，全部消除。

english: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks from Evolution Pokémon ''(after applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到进化宝可梦的招式的伤害「-100」。

english: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 50 more damage from attacks ''(after applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦所受到的招式的伤害「+50」。

english: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 30 more damage from attacks ''(after applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦所受到的招式的伤害「+30」。

english: During your opponent's next turn, Pokémon can't be played from your opponent's hand to evolve the Defending Pokémon.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，无法进化为从手牌使出的宝可梦。

english: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，对手无法从手牌使出宝可梦进行进化。

english: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，对手无法从手牌使出并附着特殊能量，也无法放置竞技场。

english: During your next turn, your Pokémon can't attack. ''(This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)''
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，自己所有的宝可梦，无法使用招式。（也包括新出场的宝可梦。）

english: Choose Item cards or Supporter cards. During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any of the chosen cards from their hand.
chinese: 自己选择物品或支援者其中一种类型。在下一个对手的回合，对手无法从手牌使出被选择的类型的训练家。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. During [[Pokémon Checkup]], your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|睡眠}}'''状态。因这个'''睡眠'''而抛掷的硬币次数变为2次，只要不是全为正面就不会恢复。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. Put 6 damage counters instead of 3 on that Pokémon for this Special Condition.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。因这个'''混乱'''而放置的伤害指示物数量变为6个。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. Put 8 damage counters instead of 3 on that Pokémon for this Special Condition.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。因这个'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''而放置的伤害指示物数量变为8个。

english: Heal 60 damage from this Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't retreat.
chinese: 回复这只宝可梦「60」HP。在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法撤退。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. During your opponent’s next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入【灼伤】状态。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，无法撤退。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''中毒'''状态。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，无法撤退。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|灼伤}}'''状态。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，无法撤退。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''中毒'''状态。在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，无法撤退。

english: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦身上附着的能量，全部放于弃牌区。在下一个对手的回合，对手无法从手牌使出物品。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''和'''{{TCG|灼伤}}'''和'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。

english: Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中的1张基本能量，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。

english: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
chinese: 选择对手的1只对战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。

english: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may attach any number of {{TCG|Basic Energy card}}s you find there to this Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
chinese: 查看自己牌库上方5张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的基本能量，附着于这只宝可梦身上。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Choose up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon and attach a Basic {{e|Fire}} Energy card from your discard pile to each of them.
chinese: 选择自己最多2只备战宝可梦，各附着1张弃牌区中的「基本'''{{e|火}}'''能量」。

english: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. ''(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)''
chinese: 给对手所有的宝可梦，各造成10伤害。''[备战宝可梦不计算弱点、抗性。]''

english: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 将5个伤害指示物，以任意方式放置于对手的备战宝可梦身上。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令对手的战宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: Attach a Basic {{e|Fighting}} Energy card from your discard pile to each of your Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 给自己所有的备战宝可梦，各附着1张弃牌区中的「基本{{e|斗}}能量」。

english: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. ''(Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)''
chinese: 将对手的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。''''[放于战斗场的宝可梦由对手选择。]''''

english: You may put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
chinese: 若希望，可选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的2个能量，放回对手的手牌。

english: Put a Basic {{e|Grass}} Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中的1张「基本{{e|草}}能量」，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。

english: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 将4个伤害指示物，以任意方式放置于对手的宝可梦身上。

english: Discard all Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon.
chinese: 将对手所有宝可梦身上附着的特殊能量，全部放于弃牌区。

english: Shuffle 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
chinese: 选择自己的1只备战宝可梦，将那只宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {{e|Grass}} Energy cards and up to 2 Basic {{e|Lightning}} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中的「基本{{e|草}}能量」和「基本{{e|雷}}能量」各最多2张，以任意方式附着于自己宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: Search your deck for up to 2 {{e|Lightning}} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中最多2张{{e|雷}}宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中的1张宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。

english: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中的1张训练家，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。

english: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and heal all damage from each of your Tera Pokémon.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦身上附着的所有能量放于弃牌区，将自己所有「{{TCG|太晶}}」宝可梦的HP，全部回复。

english: You may put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
chinese: 若希望，可选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的2个能量，放回对手的手牌。

english: Search your deck for up to 3 Misty's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中最多3张「小霞的宝可梦」，在给对手看过之后加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 若希望，可以选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，转附于对手的备战宝可梦身上。

english: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
chinese: 在不看对手手牌正面的前提下，选择其中1张，放于弃牌区。

english: You may search your deck for any number of Basic Lillie's Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中任意数量的'''基础'''宝可梦的「莉莉艾的宝可梦」，放于备战区。并重洗牌库。

english: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
chinese: 若希望，可以从牌库上方抽取卡牌，直到自己的手牌变为6张为止。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 8 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''状态。因这个'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''而放置的伤害指示物数量变为8个。

english: Place 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
chinese: 给对手的1只宝可梦身上放置13个伤害指示物。

english: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
chinese: 对手将其手牌全部放回牌库并重洗牌库。然后，对手从牌库上方抽取4张卡牌。

english: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中的宝可梦和基本能量合计最多3张，在给对手看过之后放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Place damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 50.
chinese: 在对手的战斗宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「50」为止。

english: Put damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon until its remaining HP is 30.
chinese: 在对手的1只宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「30」为止。

english: Put damage counters on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon until its remaining HP is 100.
chinese: 给对手所有的备战宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP均变为「100」为止。

english: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard a card you find there.
chinese: 查看对手的手牌，选择其中1张卡牌，放于弃牌区。

english: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard all Item cards and Pokémon Tool cards you find there.
chinese: 查看对手的手牌，将其中的「物品」和「{{TCG|宝可梦道具}}」，全部放于弃牌区。

english: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.
chinese: 查看对手的手牌，选择其中1张卡牌放回对手的牌库下方。

english: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put an Item card you find there on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
chinese: 查看对手的手牌，选择其中1张物品放回对手的牌库下方。

english: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
chinese: 查看自己牌库上方4张卡牌，以任意顺序重新排列，放回牌库上方。

english: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

chinese: 选择对手备战宝可梦身上放置的任意数量的伤害指示物，转放于对手的战斗宝可梦身上。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. You may move any number of damage counters from your opponent's Pokémon to their other Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。选择对手场上宝可梦身上放置的任意数量的伤害指示物，以任意方式转放于对手场上的宝可梦身上。

english: Discard a {{TCG|Special Energy card|Special Energy}} from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个特殊能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.
chinese: 选择对手战斗场上的「宝可梦{{ex}}」身上附着的1个能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Discard up to 2 Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Pokémon.
chinese: 选择放于对手场上宝可梦身上最多2张「{{TCG|宝可梦道具}}」，放于弃牌区。

english: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中任意2张卡牌。将剩余的牌库重洗，将选择的卡牌以任意顺序重新排列，放回牌库上方。

english: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. You may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the remaining cards back into your deck.
chinese: 查看自己牌库上方8张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的宝可梦，放于备战区。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Look at the top 10 cards of your deck. You may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
chinese: 查看自己牌库上方10张卡牌，选择其中任意数量的宝可梦，放于备战区。将剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Your opponent reveals their hand. Put up to 2 Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench.
chinese: 查看对手的手牌，选择其中最多2张'''基础'''宝可梦，放于对手的备战区。

english: You may put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
chinese: 若希望，可将这只宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，放回手牌。

english: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 若希望，可以将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

english: Discard a {{e|Grass}} Energy from this Pokémon.
chinese: 选择这只宝可梦身上附着的1个{{e|草}}能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokemon until its remaining HP is 50.
chinese: 在对手战斗宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「50」为止。

english: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.
chinese: 在对手战斗宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「10」为止。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''状态。因这个'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''而放置的伤害指示物数量变为2个。

english: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
chinese: 这个招式的伤害不计算弱点、抗性。

english: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
chinese: 如果因这个招式的伤害，对手的宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''的话，则在下一个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到招式的伤害和效果影响。

english: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。然后，从自己牌库中选择1张从这只宝可梦进化而来的卡牌，放于这只宝可梦身上进行进化。并重洗牌库。

english: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10. If you placed any damage counters in this way, this attack also does 120 damage to this Pokémon.
chinese: 在对手战斗宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「10」为止。然后，给这只宝可梦造成120伤害。

english: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost {{e}}{{e}} more.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦，使用招式所需能量，增加2个{{e|无}}能量。

english: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 60 damage to the new Active Pokémon, and then flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
chinese: 选择对手的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，给新出场的宝可梦造成60伤害。抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令那只宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: Attach a Basic {{e|Grass}} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal all damage from that Pokémon.
chinese: 选择自己手牌中的1张「基本{{e|草}}能量」，附着于备战宝可梦身上。然后，回复被附着能量的宝可梦的全部HP。

english: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If you played an Ancient Supporter card from your hand during this turn, discard 3 more cards in this way.
chinese: 将对手牌库上方1张卡牌放于弃牌区。在这个回合，如果从手牌使出了「古代」支援者的话，则额外将牌库上方3张卡牌放于弃牌区。

english: Attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.
chinese: 选择自己手牌中的1张能量，附着于这只宝可梦身上。然后，回复这只宝可梦「60」HP。

english: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, ignore all Energy in this attack's cost.
chinese: 这个招式，如果这只宝可梦处于特殊状态的话，则即使这只宝可梦身上没有附着满足使用这个招式所需能量，依然可以使用。

english: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，放回自己的牌库。然后，选择牌库中任意卡牌最多3张，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: Your opponent discards a card from their hand. If this Pokémon evolved from {{TCG|Salandit}} during this turn, your opponent discards 2 more cards.
chinese: 对手选择对手自己的1张手牌，放于弃牌区。在这个回合，如果这只宝可梦从「夜盗火蜥」进化而来的话，则额外将2张手牌放于弃牌区。

english: During your opponent's next turn, Pokémon that have 2 or less {{TCG|Energy}} attached can't attack. ''(This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)''
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，身上附着的能量在2个及以下的所有宝可梦，无法使用招式。（也包括新出场的宝可梦。）

english: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched {{e|Lightning}} Pokémon.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦与备战区中的{{e|雷}}宝可梦互换。

english: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. ''(Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)'' If you do, this attack does 160 damage to the new Active Pokémon.
chinese: 将对手的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换（放于战斗场的宝可梦由对手选择）。然后，给新出场的宝可梦造成160伤害。

english: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different {{TCG|type}}s and attach them to your {{DL|Pokémon ex (TCG)|Tera Pokémon ex|Tera Pokémon}} in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中，最多3张属性各不同的基本能量，以任意方式附着于自己的「太晶」宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and take a Prize card.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦身上附着的所有能量放于弃牌区，自己拿取1张奖赏卡。

english: If you use this attack when you have only 1 Prize card remaining, you win this game.
chinese: 使用这个招式时，如果自己的剩余奖赏卡张数为1张的话，则这场对战算作自己的胜利。

english: If you have exactly 30 cards in your hand, take 2 Prize cards. If you do, shuffle your hand into your deck.
chinese: 如果自己的手牌为30张的话，则拿取自己的2张奖赏卡。然后，将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, attach up to 2 Basic {{e|Lightning}} Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。然后，选择自己手牌中最多2张「基本{{e|雷}}能量」，附着于这只宝可梦身上。

english: Discard 3 {{e|Lightning}} Energy from your Pokémon.
chinese: 选择自己场上宝可梦身上附着的3个{{e|雷}}能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Search your deck for up to 5 Pokémon that are the same {{TCG|type}} as any Basic Energy attached to this Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中，与这只宝可梦身上附着的基本能量相同属性的宝可梦合计最多5张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 选择自己牌库中，属性各不相同的基本能量最多3张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Basic {{e|Grass}} Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those Energy cards into your deck.
chinese: 将自己弃牌区中所有「基本{{e|草}}能量」给对手查看，将其张数×2个伤害指示物，放置于对手的1只宝可梦身上。然后，将给对手查看过的能量放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Attach up to 3 {{TCG|Energy card}}s from your opponent's discard pile to their Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 选择对手弃牌区中最多3张能量，以任意方式附着于对手的宝可梦身上。

english: You may put this Pokémon into your hand. ''(Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.)''
chinese: 若希望，可以将这只宝可梦放回手牌。（除宝可梦以外的卡牌全部放于弃牌区。）

english: Flip a coin for each Maushold you have in play. For each heads, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.
chinese: 抛掷与自己场上的「一家鼠」数量相同次数的硬币，从对手牌库上方将出现正面次数×2张卡牌放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play and use it as this attack.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择对手场上的宝可梦所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

english: Your opponent chooses an attack from 1 of their Pokémon in play. Use the chosen attack as this attack.
chinese: 对手选择对手自己场上的宝可梦所拥有的1个招式。将被选择的招式作为这个招式使用。

english: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, choose 1 of its attacks and use it as this attack. ''(Pokémon ex, {{TCG|Pokémon V}}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)''
chinese: 将自己牌库上方1张卡牌放于弃牌区，如果那张卡牌是宝可梦（除「拥有规则的宝可梦」外）的话，则选择那只宝可梦所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

english: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
chinese: 选择对手战斗场上的「太晶」宝可梦所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面，则选择对手战斗宝可梦所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

english: Choose 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
chinese: 选择自己备战区中的「{{TCGPM|N的宝可梦}}」所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

english: Reveal the top 10 cards of your opponent's deck. You may choose an attack from a Pokémon you find there and use it as this attack. Shuffle the revealed cards into your opponent's deck.
chinese: 将对手牌库上方10张卡牌翻到正面。若希望，可以选择其中的宝可梦所拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。将翻到正面的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。

english: For each of your Benched Houndour, search your deck for a Basic {{e|Darkness}} Energy card and attach it to that Houndour. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 给自己备战区中所有的「戴鲁比」，各附着1张牌库中的「基本{{e|恶}}能量」。并重洗牌库。

english: Choose Basic {{e|Lightning}} Energy cards from your discard pile up to the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like.
chinese: 选择自己弃牌区中最多与对手已经获得的奖赏卡张数相同数量的「基本{{e|雷}}能量」，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦身上。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面，则选择自己牌库中的1张宝可梦，与这只宝可梦互换（放于其身上的卡牌、伤害指示物、特殊状态、效果等会全部继承）。如果互换了的话，则将这张卡牌放回牌库。并重洗牌库。

english: Until the end of your next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Weakness is now {{e|Colorless}}. ''(The amount of Weakness doesn't change.)''
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合结束前，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦弱点变为{{e|无}}属性。［弱点按「×2」进行伤害计算。］

english: The Defending Pokémon's Weakness is now {{e|Lightning}} until the end of your next turn. ''(Apply Weakness as ×2.)''
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合结束前，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦的弱点变为{{e|雷}}属性。［弱点按「×2」计算伤害。］

english: During your opponent's next turn, whenever they flip a coin, treat it as tails.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，将对手抛掷的硬币的结果，全部视作反面。

english: During your next turn, if the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out, take 2 more Prize cards.
chinese: 在下一个自己的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时，多拿取2张奖赏卡。

english: During your opponent's next turn, if they attach an Energy card from their hand to the Defending Pokémon, their turn ends.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，如果对手从手牌将能量附着于受到这个招式影响的宝可梦身上的话，对手的回合结束。

english: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to each of your Future Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon ex. If this Pokémon is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，自己所有的「未来」宝可梦，不会受到「宝可梦{{ex}}」的招式的伤害。如果这只宝可梦离开战斗场的话，则这个效果消除。

english: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, {{TCG|Energy card}}s can't be attached from your opponent's hand to that Pokémon.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''状态。在下一个对手的回合，无法从手牌将能量附着于受到这个招式影响的宝可梦身上。

english: During your opponent's next turn, whenever they try to use a Trainer card from their hand, they flip a coin. If tails, your opponent discards that Trainer card instead of using it.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，每当对手从手牌使出训练家时，在使用前抛掷1次硬币。如果为反面，则那张卡牌不视作被使用过，将其放于弃牌区。

english: Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards.
chinese: 选择对手反面朝上的1张奖赏卡，查看那张卡牌的正面后放回原处。
